# onpager_group (Data Source)

Read one OnPager group through authorized configuration reads. Absence, ambiguity and denied reads are errors. Reads never modify configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onpager_group" "example" {
  key = "operations"
}

output "group_id" {
  value = data.onpager_group.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Stable OnPager UUID. Configure exactly one identity selector. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID; computed when another selector is configured.
- `key` (String) Exact immutable key. Configure exactly one identity selector. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes; computed when another selector is configured.
- `name` (String) Exact case-sensitive name, preserving whitespace. Configure exactly one identity selector. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes; use `id` for longer stored names. Computed when another selector is configured.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Observed group description; an empty string is preserved.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether this is a system group, including the derived All Users group. Reads never change membership.

## Selection

Configure exactly one of `id`, `key` or `name`. The immutable key is unique
within the tenant; names can repeat. Name matching is exact and case-sensitive.
The provider preserves case and surrounding whitespace in names and keys.

Key and name lookups use an exact server-side filter with `limit=2`. Zero
matches, multiple matches or `has_more` produce a diagnostic. Each filter value
is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and the full JSON filter to 8192 bytes. UUID
selection reads the group directly and bypasses these filter limits.

The unique match is read directly by UUID before its metadata is returned.

## Read behavior

Reads group metadata, including system groups such as the derived All Users
group. Groups have no inactive state; deleted groups are absent. Missing groups,
denied access, malformed responses and transport failures produce diagnostics.

## Permissions

Requires the tenant grant `groups.read` for personal tokens and service
accounts.
